fields.label: Snippe API Key
fields.description: API key from Snippe Dashboard → Settings → API Keys. Starts with snp_

fields.label: Snippe API URL
fields.description: Base URL for Snippe API (e.g., https://api.snippe.sh)

fields.label: Webhook Signing Secret
fields.description: From Snippe Dashboard → Settings → Webhook Secret. Used to verify incoming webhook signatures.

fields.label: Card Redirect URL
fields.description: Page the customer returns to after a successful card payment. Required for card collections.

fields.label: Card Cancel URL
fields.description: Page the customer returns to after cancelling a card payment. Uses the Card Redirect URL when empty.

fields.label: Auto-create Sales Invoice from Sales Order
fields.description: If checked, completing a payment collection against a Sales Order will automatically create and submit a corresponding Sales Invoice.

fields.label: Snippe GL Account
fields.description: ERPNext GL account representing Snippe collected funds (used when auto-creating Payment Entries)

fields.label: Default Payout Narration
fields.description: Default narration shown on recipient's mobile/bank statement for disbursements
